title: ReseedSilo overwrites account stalk per token (= not +=), zeroing multi-token depositors
description: reseedSiloDeposit computes accountStalk for one token then sets s.accts[deposits.accounts].stalk = accountStalk (line 164, assignment not increment). init() calls reseedSiloDeposit six times (bean, beanEth, beanWstEth, bean3Crv, urBean, urBeanLp) against the same s.accts mapping. Any account holding deposits in more than one token has its stalk overwritten on each subsequent token pass, so its final stalk equals only the stalk from the last token reseeded (urBeanLp). Verified directly: line 164 uses = inside the per-account loop, and init() invokes the function once per token.
impact: Every multi-token depositor loses all stalk except their last-token contribution after the L1->L2 reseed, permanently reducing or zeroing their governance weight and earned-Bean (yield) share. Stalk is consumed by LibSilo root issuance and LibReceiving earned-Bean distribution; the loss is permanent post-migration with no user-recoverable path. Deterministic for the large class of holders with deposits in >1 whitelisted token.

ite.intent: Strip multi-token depositors of stalk (governance weight + yield) during migration
ite.technique: Per-token assignment s.accts[account].stalk = accountStalk (ReseedSilo.sol:164) inside init()'s six sequential reseedSiloDeposit calls
ite.evasion: init has no per-account reconciliation; the require checks only validate per-token deposited totals, not cumulative stalk

ice_chain.corrupted_state: s.accts[account].stalk (set to last-token value, not the sum across tokens)
ice_chain.consumer_function: LibSilo.mintActiveStalk/balanceOfEarnedBeans and governance vote-weight readers read s.accts[].stalk
ice_chain.consumer_action: scales yield distribution and voting power by understated stalk
